name: LaTeX
description: Code intelligence for LaTeX documents using your TeX distribution for builds.
about: In Gode’s editor, you can complete commands, see errors and warnings, inspect hover information, go to definitions, find references and rename symbols in LaTeX files. The language server starts when a LaTeX file opens in a project and stops when none are open. Building documents uses your installed TeX distribution.
